limitations.note: The rewrite still exposes the newly incremented or loaded count on the same edge, rather than registering the pre-edge value of `num` alongside `zero`.
The rewrite asserts `zero` during asynchronous reset, whereas both the original and the reference clear it.
The test expects a set value to appear on the same rising edge that loads it, so its passing result validates the rewrite’s timing rather than checking the required output delay.
